rules.title: 实验器材与任务匹配性校验
rules.summary: 避免在存在高精度替代方案时使用高误差的动力学间接测量
rules.trigger: 当预测方案所需的测量精度远超给定器材（如用秒表测微小转动惯量差异）时
rules.check_logic: 评估方案的误差传递，若中间变量（如时间t）的微小误差导致结果剧烈波动，则方案不可行。

rules.summary: 计算球体转动惯量时，密度 $10^3$ 与半径五次方 $10^{-10}$ 的量级耦合。

rules.summary: 分层密度球体的转动惯量叠加计算
rules.trigger: 计算具有内外径的非均匀密度球体或厚球壳的转动惯量时
rules.check_logic: 必须使用大实心球减去小实心球的惯量贡献（I = I_outer - I_inner），严禁直接套用薄壳公式 (2/3MR^2)。

llm_problem_phrases: A finite straight wire carries a steady current I; determine the magnetic field at a point located at a perpendicular distance R from the wire's midpoint, using the Biot-Savart law and verifying the result via Ampere's law.

Calculate the magnetic field along the axis of a circular current loop of radius R carrying current I, and analyze how the field varies with distance from the center using symmetry arguments and integral evaluation.

llm_problem_phrases: A long solenoid with n turns per unit length carries a time-varying current I(t) = I₀ sin(ωt). Calculate the induced EMF in a coaxial circular loop of radius r located outside the solenoid but within the magnetic field region, and determine the mutual inductance between the solenoid and the loop.

Two identical coaxial circular coils of radius R are separated by a distance d. When a current I flows through one coil, it induces a magnetic flux through the other. Derive an expression for the mutual inductance M in terms of R and d, and analyze how M changes as d approaches zero.

A superconducting ring of inductance L is initially carrying a current I₀. At t = 0, a small resistance is introduced into the ring. Model the decay of the current and determine the time constant of the decay, explaining why the decay is exponential despite the absence of resistive dissipation in the ideal case.

rules.title: 近轴折射几何简化
rules.summary: 小角度近似下，折射引起的偏转角与离轴距离呈线性或平方关系

from the average speed sqrt(8kT/πm) and number density n = P/(kT), we get J ∝ P/T
the rate J involves 1/4 * sqrt(8kT/πm) and this becomes 1/sqrt(2π) after simplification

rules.title: 稀薄气体自由膨胀捕获模型
rules.summary: 气体在真空中无碰撞膨胀，特定时间后局部捕获分子的动能分布计算。
rules.trigger: 出现“mean free path >> r”、“walls break”及“after time tau, trap gas”

rules.title: 变质量浮力平衡校验

rules.title: 折射率基本定义校验
rules.summary: 区分真空波长与介质波长，避免将光速直接除以波长作为折射率。
